jobs.description:
Harness  is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle. 
 Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.  
 Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.  
 With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster. 
  Position Summary  
 We are seeking an experienced, highly technical and customer-centric Forward Deployed Engineer - DevOps/SRE to join our Customer Success team. In this role, you will play a crucial role as a technical solution expert and advisor working closely with some of the largest Harness AppSec customers to design, implement and optimize Harness platform and adoption strategies to ensure they realize maximum value and outcomes. 
 Our team is small, collaborative, and deeply motivated — we work at the intersection of technology, security, and business, and we bring curiosity and rigor to a wide range of challenges. You will have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a rapidly growing company while helping customers harness the power of our AI-enabled DevSecOps platform to build and deliver software securely and efficiently — including protecting AI applications from emerging threats. 
 We prioritize psychological safety, mentorship, and continuous learning. Whether you're coming from engineering, architecture, consulting, or security — we want to hear from you. 
  About the role  
 
 Serve as the primary technical owner of customer implementations and adoption programs across the Harness AppSec portfolio, developing deep familiarity with each customer's environment, goals, and success criteria 
 Provide hands-on technical guidance and consulting to customers throughout the customer lifecycle, from onboarding and implementation to adoption and value realization. 
 Develop strategic account success plans to ensure successful operationalization and value realization and drive alignment with all levels of customer leadership. 
 Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Harness platform and AppSec modules as well as general skillset across AI applications and security, DevOps, SecOps, application security, cloud architectures, networks and infrastructure disciplines and industry trends to effectively support, educate and advise customers. 
 Proactively analyze customer usage data to surface trends, adoption gaps, and optimization opportunities — delivering actionable recommendations across technology, process, and people dimensions. 
 Bring constructive feedback from customers to product management to improve the solution, and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, and engineering, to drive the successful adoption, integration, and ongoing optimization of our solution.

You work across several Enterprise and Public Sector customers in parallel, taking each platform engagement from the first technical conversation to a deployment that is live, adopted and operable by the customer.     Why deepset   At deepset, we’re on a mission to make custom AI solutions accessible to every organization. With Haystack, thousands of developers build advanced LLM applications every day, while our enterprise-ready AI Platform helps companies turn large language models into business value. We’re remote-first, flexible, and built on a culture of trust and ownership. You’ll collaborate with top-tier tech talent, tackle meaningful challenges, and help transform complex AI into solutions that are simple, powerful, and ready for the real world.     What you will do     Own platform outcomes from PoC to production for HEP and deepset’s partner software across several customers’ clouds or datacenters, using Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm.    Assist the Solutions team in pre-sales when required: infrastructure sizing, security reviews, deployment feasibility and effort estimates.    Unblock enterprise environments: identity (OIDC/SAML), networking, storage, secrets, GPU scheduling and observability.    Define production readiness with each customer (SLOs, dashboards, alerting), run upgrades and security patches, and lead root cause analysis on platform incidents.    Enable customer teams with runbooks, DR procedures and knowledge transfer, and hand off cleanly to Maintenance and Support.    Build reusable reference architectures and templates, and upstream proven patterns to Product and Engineering.    Keep several engagements moving in parallel and surface new environments, teams and use cases to the account team.       What you bring to the team     3+ years in SRE, platform or DevOps roles with customer-facing deployments (5+ for Senior).    Strong Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS), Linux, Terraform, Helm and CI/CD.    Networking (TLS, DNS, ingress, load balancing) and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).    Enterprise integration knowledge: SSO, secrets management, security and compliance.    Hands-on Python and Bash, plus strong AI fluency with agentic toolsets for triage, debugging and IaC.    Consulting or professional services background.    A track record of running several customer engagements in parallel and communicating clearly with technical and business stakeholders.    Nice to have    Experience with deepset’s Haystack Enterprise Platform (HEP) or Haystack open source framework    German Native, Business fluent    Sovereign or air-gapped deployments (STACKIT, OVHcloud, IONOS) and GPU/LLM serving (vLLM, NVIDIA GPU Operator)    Certifications such as CKA, CKS or Red Hat OpenShift    Benefits    Remote-first setup with flexible hours & tech of your choice    30 days vacation + extra days for family sick leave    Competitive salary & stock options for every team member    Monthly sports & mental health support allowance with Oliva    Annual learning & development budget    Monthly team socials & in-person meetups    Dog-friendly Berlin HQ        About us   Founded in 2018, deepset builds open and enterprise-grade tools that help teams build AI with purpose. From Haystack, our open-source framework, to the Haystack Enterprise Platform, we give developers and organizations the building blocks to solve complex, high impact challenges with AI with full control, transparency, and sovereignty. Backed by GV and Balderton, we’re growing the world’s production AI community and customer base solving challenges too critical to get wrong.  ‍ Visit us to learn more:    deepset Website   |   Haystack Websi
